title: Read-through caching for queries
summary: A query implements ICacheable and states its own key and lifetime; a pipeline behaviour answers it from the store and puts the answer back. Only successes are stored, only queries are cached, and a command drops what it made wrong by the same key the query wrote.
useWhen: A read is expensive and a slightly stale answer is acceptable. Do not cache inside a handler, do not write your own cache abstraction or key builder, and do not derive a cache key by serialising the request.
